name_zh: 博尔基亚/马来伊斯兰君主制：石油财富分配与马来伊斯兰君主制
name_en: Bolkiah/Malay Islamic Monarchy: Oil Wealth Distribution & Malay Islamic Monarchy
description_zh: 文莱哈桑纳尔·博尔基亚 (1946-) 1967- 执政/世界最长在位君主/石油天然气人均 GDP 东南亚最高/马来伊斯兰君主制 (MIB)/沙里亚法/福利国家/免费医疗/教育/住房/无税/主权财富基金/2020s 多元化/旅游/金融/清真/哈吉/伦敦/新加坡投资。体现 M199 马来伊斯兰君主制 — 以"石油租金福利+沙里亚法治+君主制合法性+主权财富跨代"四位一体，在微型国家/资源依赖/区域大国夹缝中实现高福利稳定统治。
description_en: Brunei Hassanal Bolkiah (1946-) 1967- reigns/world's longest-reigning monarch/oil gas GDP per capita Southeast Asia highest/Malay Islamic Monarchy (MIB)/Sharia law/welfare state/free healthcare/education/housing/tax-free/SWF/2020s diversification/tourism/finance/halal/hajj/London/Singapore investments. Exemplifies M199 Malay Islamic Monarchy — quaternity of 'oil rent welfare + Sharia rule of law + monarchical legitimacy + sovereign wealth intergenerational' achieving high-welfare stable rule amid micro-state/resource dependence/regional great power squeeze.
reason_zh: 文莱非单纯石油酋长国，而是"石油福利+马来伊斯兰君主制+主权财富"三位一体微型福利国家。石油租金支撑全民福利/免税/高收入，MIB 提供文化/宗教/政治合法性，主权财富基金跨代传承。M199 区隔于 M169 后石油转型(沙特)、M171 资源民族主义(委内瑞拉)、M195 永久中立(土库曼)，核心在于"石油租金即福利契约+马来伊斯兰即文明锚点+主权财富即代际契约"的微型资源型福利国家范式。
reason_en: Brunei not mere oil emirate but 'oil welfare + Malay Islamic Monarchy + sovereign wealth' trinity micro welfare state. Oil rent funds universal welfare/tax-free/high income, MIB provides cultural/religious/political legitimacy, SWF enables intergenerational transfer. M199 distinct from M169 Post-Oil (Saudi), M171 Resource Nationalist (Venezuela), M195 Permanent Neutrality (Turkmenistan), core: 'oil rent as welfare contract + Malay Islamic as civilizational anchor + sovereign wealth as intergenerational contract' micro resource-based welfare state paradigm.
steps_zh: 石油租金全民福利契约：石油/天然气 90%+ 出口/人均 GDP $3万+/免费医疗/教育/住房/养老/补贴/无所得税/福利即合法性
马来伊斯兰君主制 MIB：马来文化/伊斯兰信仰/君主制/三位一体/沙里亚刑法/2014 实施/宗教部/伊斯兰银行/清真认证/文化锚点
主权财富基金跨代传承：文莱投资局 BIA/伦敦/新加坡/美国/股票/债券/房产/跨代储蓄/石油枯竭后保障/透明度挑战
多元化转型与 2035 愿景：旅游/金融/清真/航空/农业/渔业/数字经济/技能培训/青年就业/减少石油依赖/区域融合
区域外交与微型国家生存：东盟/英联邦/伊斯兰合作组织/中国/美国/新加坡/马来西亚/印尼/四面平衡/微型国家外交智慧
steps_en: Oil rent universal welfare contract: oil/gas 90%+ exports/GDP per capita $30k+/free healthcare/education/housing/pension/subsidies/no income tax/welfare = legitimacy
Malay Islamic Monarchy MIB: Malay culture/Islamic faith/monarchy/trinity/Sharia penal code 2014 implemented/religious dept/Islamic banking/halal certification/cultural anchor
Sovereign wealth fund intergenerational transfer: Brunei Investment Agency BIA/London/Singapore/US/equities/bonds/real estate/intergenerational savings/post-oil security/transparency challenges
Diversification & Vision 2035: tourism/finance/halal/aviation/agriculture/fisheries/digital economy/skills training/youth employment/reduce oil dependence/regional integration
Regional diplomacy & micro-state survival: ASEAN/Commonwealth/OIC/China/US/Singapore/Malaysia/Indonesia/four-way balance/micro-state diplomatic wisdom
expected_zh: 以"石油福利+马来伊斯兰君主制+主权财富跨代"三位一体，在微型国家/资源依赖/区域大国夹缝中实现高福利稳定统治，为微型资源型国家提供福利国家范式。
expected_en: Trinity of 'oil welfare + Malay Islamic Monarchy + sovereign wealth intergenerational' achieves high-welfare stable rule amid micro-state/resource dependence/regional great power squeeze, providing welfare state paradigm for micro resource-based nations.
